purpose: Retest the EC800K board after moving the SIM into a phone for data usage and then reinserting it into the device.
conclusion: Using the SIM for phone data and reinserting it changed the PDP IP address but did not remove the carrier-side HTTP/WebSocket redirect.
Direct plain WebSocket to the cloud OpenClaw gateway still fails because the request is rewritten to HTTP/1.1 302 Found.
High-level HTTPS on the device still fails with USSL ECONNRESET, so TLS capability/path also remains blocked.
Both the current qpyclaw runtime and the historical lcc-claw-node-qpy runtime fail the same way on the same board and cloud path.
